label_set_standing: PROVISIONAL - one candidate set among several; no set selected

qualification_state.mechanical_record_tokens: CURRENT_V3; does not ratify explanatory labels

label_qualification.followup: Recover actual prior formulations and established terms of art; run semantic boundary contrasts and reader-intelligibility cases before proposing settled names. Do not block ECO-202 current wire-token use.

standing: Prospective qualification design, not an actual semantic, empirical, hosted-use or independent validation result

cases.focal_referent: one versioned non-conscious execution occurrence; not its program text or replay
cases.discriminator: two behaviorally equivalent runs retain distinct proper occurrence IDs; evidence accounts, actual run and reproduction never substitute
cases.necessary_basis: actual execution, attributable semantic producer, current account editions and exact evidence recovery
cases.defeater: the producer merges two execution tokens because outputs are equal

cases.focal_referent: one versioned protocol execution; field interpretation remains referent-bound
cases.discriminator: valid versus invalid transition in a versioned operative protocol changes accepted downstream action, while neither physical coupling nor an observer description alone supplies the distinction
cases.necessary_basis: attributable rule edition, conditions, actual transition evidence, referent participation and independently recovered characterization
cases.defeater: LL is filled from merely descriptive notes with no warranted operative consequence

cases.focal_referent: one bounded experimentally prepared atom, not its physicist or model
cases.discriminator: a scientist's symmetry description by itself cannot settle the atom's domain-native LL participation
cases.necessary_basis: UL/UR/LR may be authored, LL remains QF unless physical articulation with discriminating consequences is independently established
cases.defeater: mapper theory alone is accepted as atom LL and closes fourfold coverage

cases.focal_referent: same atom and boundary as A1
cases.discriminator: physical interaction/coupling alone can support LR but cannot certify LL field articulation
cases.necessary_basis: unresolved LL question retained with source and reentry route
cases.defeater: a coupling diagram or interaction record is automatically promoted to LL

cases.focal_referent: model of original experiment, explicitly reseated as distinct referent
cases.discriminator: original atom accounts cannot satisfy model's new fourfold merely by copied labels
cases.necessary_basis: new focal/boundary, typed change and requalified model accounts; deliberately omit these in the negative control
cases.defeater: inherited old atom disclosure accounts yield READY for the new model

cases.focal_referent: versioned referent graph with constituent, participation, source and unresolved-LL obligations
cases.discriminator: fold/unfold/zoom/reseat preserve declared identity, provenance, QF, traversal and later recontact paths, or disclose attributable losses
cases.necessary_basis: actual transformation receipt with before/after account identity and recovery tasks under declared scope
cases.defeater: apparently equivalent summary silently loses member, unknown, source or later recontact

cases.discriminator: matched evidence and task budget; independently adjudicated valid novel findings and recoverability under each inquiry condition
cases.necessary_basis: frozen material, independently selected comparator, blind raters, predeclared validity and cost metrics
cases.defeater: ablations or a nonquadrant rival match or exceed full fourfold without loss of required affordances

cases.focal_referent: independently selected physical experiment with bounded atom and explicit mapper/instrument reseating
cases.discriminator: same material and budget, separate distinctions grounded in the physical referent versus its scientific model
cases.necessary_basis: preregistered rival grammar, independent adjudication and unknown-preservation scoring
cases.defeater: LL remains permanently non-discriminating or rival grammar achieves equal/better qualified performance
